verdict.rationale: E2B's core product is secure, isolated cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code. Agent tools run in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of the user's machine or server, which keeps testing away from production. Outbound network can be restricted with on/off or allow/deny lists, and templates, snapshots and pause/resume make repeatable, disposable test environments easy to spin up and kill. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the isolation holds in practice, and no explicit documentation framing sandboxes against production-data access.
